maps.name: Mammoth Valley
maps.blurb: One long winding trail that crosses itself. Towers at the crossing hit robots twice.

maps.name: Glacier Pass
maps.blurb: Robots skid fast down the ice slide, then wade slowly through deep snow. Kill them in the drift.

maps.name: Volcano Ridge
maps.blurb: Two portals. Their trails meet and dive into a lava tube where no tower can reach them.

maps.name: River Delta
maps.blurb: Portals north and south. Both roads meet at the only bridge, then slog through the riverbank mud.

maps.name: Desert Citadel
maps.blurb: The road spirals into the citadel, then vanishes into the catacombs and bursts out at your gate.

maps.name: Copper Canyon
maps.blurb: Two mines. Robots ride minecart rails at double speed, and one trail runs through a mine shaft.

maps.name: Highland Ford
maps.blurb: The road fords the cold stream three times. Robots wade slowly through every crossing.

maps.name: Ember Forge
maps.blurb: A time rift flickers in the forge. Robots step in on the left and walk out on the right.

maps.name: Mirefen Bog
maps.blurb: Two plank roads cross in the marsh. Robots sink into the mud where they meet.

maps.name: Olive Hills
maps.blurb: Robots run fast downhill and trudge slowly back up. A second trail joins halfway down the slope.

maps.name: Marble Coast
maps.blurb: Two roads pass under old aqueducts, where robots are out of reach, then cross the inlet bridge.

maps.name: Acropolis
maps.blurb: The main road loops around the temple hill and crosses itself. A short back stair comes from the north.

maps.name: Hedgerow Fields
maps.blurb: Two lanes cross each other twice between the hedges. Cloakers hide in the crowd.

maps.name: Castle Siege
maps.blurb: Two armies circle the castle, one over the north wall and one under the south. They meet in the moat at the back gate.

maps.name: Darkwood
maps.blurb: The woods twist you around: near the end a rift throws the robots back to the start for a second lap.

maps.name: Smuggler's Harbor
maps.blurb: One road crosses the harbor bridge. The smugglers' road sneaks under the water in a tunnel.

maps.name: Star Fort
maps.blurb: The road traces the star fort's bastions, zigzagging around a walled field in the middle.

maps.name: Jungle Outpost
maps.blurb: Three trails out of the jungle. Robots zip down the vines fast before the trails meet.

maps.name: Railyard
maps.blurb: Robots ride the rails at double speed. Two lines cross in the middle of the yard.

maps.name: Foundry Row
maps.blurb: An assembly line: conveyor belts rush robots along, and the smelter swallows them for a moment.

maps.name: Smog City
maps.blurb: Three portals in the smog. Two roads run through the sewers before everything meets downtown.

maps.name: Suburbia
maps.blurb: Robots drive a full lap around the block, then race down the highway. A second road joins the highway.

maps.name: Airbase
maps.blurb: Robots taxi down the runway at full speed and cut through the hangar, where you can't hit them.

maps.name: Downtown
maps.blurb: Two highways cross downtown. Robots jam up in the traffic at the crossing, then take the subway.

maps.name: Neon Grid
maps.blurb: Data highways and three rifts. Robots blink across the grid; watch the arrows to see where they land.

maps.name: Dish Array
maps.blurb: The road curls around the big dish and into its center, where the uplink beams robots to your gate.

maps.name: Cleanroom
maps.blurb: Airlocks hide the robots, decontamination slows them, and a rift skips the last corridor.

maps.name: Server Hall
maps.blurb: Two data streams braid together, crossing four times. They race down data lanes and duck into cable ducts.

maps.name: Coolant Vaults
maps.blurb: Three portals in the vaults. Robots crawl through coolant pipes and slip on frozen floors.

maps.name: The Core
maps.blurb: Three portals, chained rifts and data highways spiral into THE CORE. End it.
